agents.name: lead
agents.description: Lead architect and orchestrator: plans milestones, delegates, reviews, keeps STATUS/DECISIONS in order

agents.name: compiler-dev
agents.description: Implements lexer, parser, AST, declarations, binder, type system, codegen, optimizer, formatter

agents.name: vm-dev
agents.description: Implements bytecode, .kbc format, VM/interpreter, async scheduler, threads, reflection runtime, native binding framework

agents.name: std-dev
agents.description: Implements the standard library (Kern.Runtime domains and Kern.Std .kern files) on top of the native binding attributes

agents.name: cli-dev
agents.description: Implements kernc CLI, project model, build.kern builder, kbc stubs/linker, macros pipeline, fmt, repl

agents.name: qa
agents.description: Writes xunit tests and golden-test expectations from the spec, runs examples, triages failures

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Read-only reviewer: checks a change against the spec and DECISIONS, finds bugs and spec drift

agents.name: mechanic
agents.description: Cheap mechanical fixes: missing usings, CRLF/tabs, renames, doc sync, formatting, repetitive edits
